title: Bologna Children’s Book Fair 2025
summary: Our second year with our own stand, with talks and a workshop by our authors.
body:
Our second year with our own stand in Bologna, with rights meetings and events at the Türkiye collective stand by our authors Ahmet Coşkun, Ezo Sunal and Özlem Fedai Korçak.

[Read our report from the fair](/news/bologna-childrens-book-fair-2025/)
